text:
Maya K.: Quick sync — release train tomorrow morning. We need volunteers for deploy slots and smoke checks. Who can take 09:00 PT for model-serving v2?

Jun Park: I can take 09:00 PT. Will run the canary and hold for +15.

Carlos R.: I’ll own the 11:00 PT infra window (cache + KV warmup).

Priya S.: Can we confirm rollback plan and who can execute? Also any special data-migration steps?

Maya K.: Rollback is standard pin to previous image tag + route rewrite. No DB migrations for this train. Rollback steps in runbook. Quick snippet:
```
# rollback example
docker tag redwood/model-serving:v2-prev prod/model-serving:stable
kubectl set image deploy/model-serving model-serving=prod/model-serving:stable -n prod
```

deploy-bot: Deploy job created by Jun Park for cluster prod-gpu-1. Scheduled start: 2026-03-18T16:00:00Z. ID: DPL-7893. Canary policy: 5% -> 25% -> 100%.

Leo M.: Smoke checklist I'll run after canary starts: 
- GET /health -> 200
- send sample prompt; verify p50/p95 latency
- verify tokenization and deterministic priming
- monitor GPU mem and inference errors
(Will post logs to S3)

Priya S.: I’ll join 09:15 PT for verification. @ops-oncall please standby to trigger rollback if error rate > 1% or p95 latency regresses > 30%.

ops-oncall: Oncall acknowledged. I can trigger rollback, should be able to revert within ~5m. Keep me pinged.

Jun Park: Plan for canary timing: 09:00 PT start -> 5% for 10m -> 25% for 10m -> 100% if green. Running smoke tests at each step. Fail criteria: 5xx spike, >1% error rate, or p95 latency +30% vs baseline.

Carlos R.: I'll warm cache and KV starting 10:30 PT ahead of my 11:00 window. Will post warmup status.

Maya K.: Ops notes: tag used for deploy is `redwood/model-serving:v2-rc3`. If we need to rollback we revert to `redwood/model-serving:v2-rc2`.

Jun Park: Starting canary checklist (short):
1) deploy canary (5%)
2) run health & sample prompt smoke
3) check traces for errors
4) bump to 25% if all green
(Posting results below as I go)

deploy-bot: Jun Park started canary phase for DPL-7893 at 2026-03-18T16:00:30Z.

Leo M.: Smoke run results (canary 5%):
- /health: OK
- sample prompt p50 120ms, p95 210ms (baseline p95 200ms)
- no 5xx observed
- GPU mem 62%
Logs: s3://redwood-smoke/1771234567-canary.log

Priya S.: Verified outputs for 10 sample prompts. No regressions spotted. OK to proceed to 25%.

Jun Park: Moving to 25% now. Will monitor for 10m.

deploy-bot: Canary bumped to 25% for DPL-7893 at 2026-03-18T16:12:05Z.

Leo M.: 25% checks: p95 now 230ms (slight bump), error rate 0.3%. All under thresholds.

Priya S.: I’m happy to give final go at 09:40 PT if metrics stay good.

ops-oncall: Still standing by.

Jun Park: Rolling to 100% in 2m if no issues.

deploy-bot: Deployment DPL-7893 completed to 100% at 2026-03-18T16:25:10Z.

Maya K.: Thanks everyone. Can anyone paste quick post-deploy checks (latency, cost, error) after 30m? I’ll add a note to the release train doc. :rocket:

Leo M.: Will post 30m metrics to the release doc and S3 when ready.

Carlos R.: Infra deploy went fine at 11:00 PT. Cache warmed, no errors.

Maya K.: Final: 100% green, no rollback. Closing the slot. Great work team. :tada:
